verdict.rationale: The pack shows only thin employee-facing touchpoints: an 'Interactive offer letters' line item on the pricing page and email alerts when a holder reaches a vesting event. Neither is shown to explain equity in plain language. missing for 10: plain-language explanations of tax treatment (ISO/NSO, AMT, 83(b) for employees), exercise-window explanations, dilution explanations or modeling for employees, an employee portal with educational content, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
